titleEn: Law on the Establishment of the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries

articles.en:
The Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries is hereby established under the Royal Government of Cambodia.
Article 2: The Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries shall have the competence to lead and manage the agriculture sector of the Kingdom of Cambodia.

The Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries shall be led by one Minister, who may be assisted by Secretaries of State and/or Under-Secretaries of State as necessary.
Article 4: The organisational structure and functioning of the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries shall be determined by sub-decree.
Any provisions contrary to this Law shall be considered null and void.

This Law is declared to be urgent.
Done at Phnom Penh, 24 January 1996, and respectfully submitted for the Royal signature; Norodom Sihanouk; First Prime Minister, Second Prime Minister, Norodom Ranariddh, Hun Sen.
